newsitem.title: EGYPT: MIBANK says nine-month profits up 52 pct.
newsitem.headline: MIBANK says nine-month profits up 52 pct.

text.p: Misr International Bank/MIBANK said on Sunday its net profits in the first nine months of 1996 rose 52 percent to 102 million pounds ($30 million) from 67 million in the same period of 1995.
Shareholders' funds at the end of the period on September 30, 1996, were worth 391 million pounds against 335 million one year earlier, it added.
The bank's total assets rose to 9.218 billion pounds from 8.362 billion, it said.
The bank's shareholders include state-owned Banque Misr and Misr Insurance, Banca di Roma, British Arab Commercial Bank, Central Hispano Americano Banco, Commerzbank and Sakura Bank.
The bank has 3.75 million shares and they closed last week on the Egyptian stock exchange at 500.00 pounds a share.
